heading: Nau Neih Khit A Numeite Kisiansakna

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, numei in nau apai a, tapa aneihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; numei dan ngeina hun lai a asian louh bang in siang lou ahi ding hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

paite: Ani giat ni in atapa zekmong vun asum ding ahi.
english: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

paite: Sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmthum-le-thum a-om lai ding ahi. Akisiansak ni akim mateng thilsiang himhim akhoih ding ahi kei a; mun siangthou ah leng alut ding ahi sam kei hi.
english: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

paite: "Nau numei aneihleh bel numei dan ngeina hun lai a asian louh bang in nipikal nih sung siang lou ahi dia, sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmguk- le-guk a-om lai ding ahi.
english: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

paite: "Tapa hiam, tanu hiam ziak a kisiansak ni akim chiang in halmang thillat ding in belamnou kum khat a upa leh khelh thoihna ding in vapalnou hiam, vakhu hiam kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah siampu kiang ah ahon tawi ding ahi:
english: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA ma ah alan ding a, kilemna abawlsak dia, huchi in asisan pawtna a pan asiang ding. Hiai pen pasal hiam, numei hiam neinu a dia dan ahi.
english: He shall offer it before Yahweh, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

paite: "Aneih in belamnou achin keileh vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam atawi ding ahi: Khat halmang thillat ding in, akhat pen khelh thoihna ding in. Siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”
